From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Tenant-scoped erase evidence for SIG/CAIQ

Naomi — technical summary and proposed artifact format below. High level: yes, infra can produce a sanitized, signed proof-of-delete package that meets the three items Alex requested. We do this today for forensic holds and SOC2 customer packs; we need to produce a tenant-scoped sample without any real customer content.

What we can produce (example fields):
- export_id: GUID (e.g., exp-3f9b2a) — identifier for the exported bundle prior to deletion
- erase_job_id: GUID (e.g., ej-8c7d1f) — async job tracked in the job ledger
- deleted_bundle_hash: SHA256 of the bundle before deletion (we compute on export)
- deletion_timestamp_utc: ISO8601
- operator: service account identity (redacted)
- retention_policy_reference: config path + effective TTL (e.g., tenant-config/ephemeral-logs -> 30d)
- proof_signature: RSA signature over the JSON payload by our evidence-signing key (rotation tracked)

Attached stubs: erase-job-20261215.log (sanitized job log), sample-proof-of-delete.json (redacted example). We also emit a manifest that links to the CID/Drive location we used to stage the export.

Procedure to create customer deliverable:
1) Run export for a scoped tenant partition (sanitized copy).
2) Compute SHA256 and create JSON manifest.
3) Run erase job; capture erase_job_id in ledger.
4) Sign manifest with evidence key; include signed cert chain.
5) Deliver packaged ZIP and store reference in secure drive; include a short runbook.

Constraints/notes:
- Timing: typical turnaround is 3 business days after authorization (we can do expedited in 24–48h for a fee).
- Cost: if within SOC2 annual evidence bundle for customers on enterprise plan, we can include it at no additional charge; ad-hoc one-offs for non-enterprise customers are billable.
- Audit trail: we keep an immutable ledger entry for all erase_job_ids for 90 days for internal review; the actual deleted content is unrecoverable post-erase.

I attached a sanitized job log and sample JSON. If Compliance/Legal wants a signed affidavit, we can coordinate that as well — requires legal signoff.

Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: erase-job-20261215.log, sample-proof-of-delete.json
